Lemma
[Pinching of Ricci eigenvalues] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0232 1. Lemma 6.65\group exponential-convergence

For a normalized Ricci flow solution on a closed three-manifold of initially positive Ricci curvature, there exists a constant $B$ such that the largest Ricci eigenvalue $\lambda $ satisfies \[ \lambda \le B(\mu +\nu ) \] for all positive time.
